source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: crowdwork OR "crowd work" OR microwork OR "online labour" OR "algorithmic management"
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:crowdwork OR "crowd work" OR microwork OR "online labour" OR "algorithmic management",is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("algorithmic management" OR "crowd work" OR "online labour" OR "crowdwork" OR "microwork")
